from cyhole import Jupiter
from solders.pubkey import Pubkey

# Initialize Jupiter
jupiter = Jupiter()

# SOL and USDC mint addresses on Solana
SOL_MINT = Pubkey("So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112")
USDC_MINT = Pubkey("EPjFWaLb3odccccccccccccccccccccccccpgc7j5H")

# Amount to swap: 1 SOL (in lamports)
amount_in_lamports = 1_000_000

# Request a swap quote
quote = jupiter.get_quote(
    input_mint=SOL_MINT,
    output_mint=USDC_MINT,
    amount=amount_in_lamports
)

print(f"Quote: {quote}")

# Execute the swap
swap_result = jupiter.execute_swap(quote)

print(f"Swap executed: {swap_result}")
